registry_order_disposition.explanation: Link-set section placement moves32 GLOBAL descriptors to Rust; show row order changes. No record, file/function/line selector, flags or update traversal is dropped. show enumerates start..stop; store applies predicate to every record without index-based addressing. No byte-identical sysfs listing claim.
